title: S7 formal exchange declaration completeness
test_intent: Determine whether a planned or executed formal exchange is sufficiently declared for the receiving party to identify the issued information, purpose, scope, milestone context, permitted use, and issue record without inference.

applicability.applies_when: A project declares or executes a formal information exchange or deliverable issue under S7.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested event is only a technical transfer with no claim of formal exchange or delivery.

required_evidence: project deliverable declaration or BEP deliverable list
issue/transmittal record or planned record mechanism
review and acceptance-route references where applicable

result_logic.pass: The exchange and its expected deliverables are declared with the applicable governed fields and can be interpreted without relying on undocumented assumptions.
result_logic.fail: A formal exchange is missing material declaration fields such as purpose, scope, intended use, milestone/event context, deliverable references, issue record, or applicable review/acceptance route.
result_logic.not_applicable: No formal exchange is asserted for the tested transfer or event.
result_logic.indeterminate: The governing project deliverable/exchange declaration or applicable authority references are unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Derived from GAP-S7-01 source scaffold and current S7 formal-exchange requirements. Project dates, formats, paths, and authority assignments remain project-specific.
